description: Use when you need to find pages on the live web: search the live web: the most relevant pages for a query (title, URL, short snippet), best first, plus a short answer drawn only from those pages when the query is a question. Every URL is checked against the pages the search actually returned. Optional site filter. Free trials are limited each day. US$0.02 per call; 3 free calls a day.
